newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 21.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Violence erupts at Hsinchu juvenile detention centre, causing one death, four injuries.
United States will not change policy of selling armaments to Taiwan.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Parliament approves measure to give government workers two off days per week.
Emotions run high at Taichung detention centre, echoing violence in Hsinchu.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan will rely on strength of private enterprises for support at Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.
Taiwan will sign government purchase agreement after entering World Trade Organisation.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Export growth slows in October.
World Trade Organisation talks between Taiwan and U.S. end without major conclusions.
